subject: Request: 6-month compute stipend for Rural Data Justice Fellowship
messages:
From: Anita Das <anita@communitybridge.org>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Miles Chen <miles.chen@openpolicy.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Compute stipend request — Rural Data Justice Fellowship

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well — I lead operations for the Rural Data Justice Fellowship at Community Bridge. We run a cohort of 12 researchers from community organizations who do policy and dataset work in under-resourced regions. Our pilot relied heavily on small GPU credits, and several fellows have hit the project cap while finishing final analyses.

Would Redwood consider a six-month compute stipend (approx. $6k in credits) to help complete three projects tied to open data publication and model transparency? I’ve attached the fellowship proposal and a short budget. A stipend here would directly enable final model checks, privacy-preserving aggregation, and public release of cleaned datasets.

If helpful, we can do a 20-minute call next week — otherwise, a written confirmation of eligibility/amount and any required paperwork would work. We’re a 501(c)(3); I can share our IRS letter and a short impact statement.

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Das
Operations Director, Community Bridge
anita@communitybridge.org
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: fellowship-proposal-2026.pdf (PDF), budget-breakdown.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Anita Das <anita@communitybridge.org>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compute stipend request — Rural Data Justice Fellowship

Hi Anita —

Thanks for the note and for sending the materials. I read the proposal and budget; this looks aligned with the sorts of community research pilots we prioritize. A couple quick clarifying questions before I loop in our grants/pricing team:

- Can you confirm the cohort start/end dates and the month-by-month compute burn estimate? (we saw a spike in month 4 last year)
- Is there any sensitive PII in the datasets that would require additional safeguards or an in-region private deployment?

I’ve cc’d Neha (partnerships lead) and Ben (program finance) so we can evaluate credit vs reserved discount and any need for a purchase order or MOU. I’m out Monday morning but can hop on Tuesday 9/22 after 10am PT if that works for you.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Programs Liaison, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

Thanks for forwarding, Priya. Quick notes from my side after reviewing the proposal:

- Impact fit: strong — public datasets + transparency work aligns with our EDU/Nonprofit credits program.
- Operational ask: $6k of hosted credits over 6 months is within precedent, but Ben will need a short MOU and confirmation of 501(c)(3) status to approve.
- Risk: there are references to small PII fields; we should specify that any raw PII must be removed before ingest or agree to use redwood-private if they require retention.

Ben — can you put together the simple MOU template and confirm whether we should route this through a promotional credits grant or a one-off contract discount?

Neha

Hi all —

I reviewed the attachments. Budget lines look reasonable. Two operational items:

1) We can approve a $6,000 promotional credit package spread over six months under our nonprofit credits policy. This would be hosted credits applied to a single account.
2) Requirements: we need the IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter and a short recipient agreement. I attached a one-page MOU template (filename: redwood-mou-template.pdf) — Anita, if you can sign and return we’ll push the credits within 2 business days of receiving the signed MOU and IRS proof.

One caveat: if the fellowship needs data residency or retention beyond our standard policy, we’ll need to discuss a Private deployment option and additional costs.

Ben
Ben Carter
Programs Finance, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-mou-template.pdf
From: Anita Das <anita@communitybridge.org>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compute stipend request — Rural Data Justice Fellowship

Hi Ben / Neha / Priya —

Thanks — attaching the signed MOU and our IRS letter. We do not plan to retain raw PII on Redwood-hosted endpoints; all uploads will be de-identified and encrypted client-side. Cohort timeline: Oct 1, 2026 — Mar 31, 2027. Monthly estimate: 1.0–1.5 GPU hours per fellow with a peak month in Jan.

I’ve uploaded the signed files here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFellowshipProposal (see redwood-folder). Please let me know when the credits are applied so we can notify fellows.

Best,
Anita
